== Summary ==
Identified: [[Chris Menzel]] (black shirt, glasses, white beard; same face as [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 5.jpg]]). The man in the white Jack & Jones shirt is the same person as the pink shirt in [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 2.jpg]] and is not named. A player in a black Ketwol stormtrooper shirt, seen from behind, and other tables are not named.

Main event at the 2023 Naboo Regionals ("Foil Fest") weekend in Liverpool, UK, 3 June 2023, hosted by Team Wales.

* '''Event:''' [[2023 Regional Championships]]
* '''Date:''' 3 June 2023
* '''Date posted:''' 2023-06-03
* '''Identification:''' [[Chris Menzel]] (black shirt, glasses, white beard; same face as [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 5.jpg]]). The man in the white Jack & Jones shirt is the same person as the pink shirt in [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 2.jpg]] and is not named. A player in a black Ketwol stormtrooper shirt, seen from behind, and other tables are not named.
